landing.donateButton: Support on Buy Me a Coffee
landing.heroSubtitle: Add grandparents, parents, children — with photos and stories — and watch your whole family come to life in a family tree you can build in minutes, not a whole weekend. No hidden catch: free now, free 10 years from now.
landing.heroFootnote: No subscription. No card at sign-up. No "free trial" that quietly turns into a charge. You can optionally support the project with a donation.
landing.agitateBody: Do you know exactly how your grandparents met? Do you know which child your grandmother was, or what your great-grandfather did for a living? If the answer is "not really," you're not alone — because no one ever wrote it down anywhere. Photos forgotten on old phones. The names of great-grandparents no one remembers anymore. With every generation that passes, a piece of your family's history disappears forever — and it can't be recovered.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you get, free — no compromises
landing.featuresSubtitle: No feature locked behind a subscription. No ads. No artificial limits.
landing.shareTitle: You don't have to do this alone
landing.shareBody: Send a link, and the rest of your family fills in the tree together with you — no account, no password, no hassle. You decide exactly how much they can see or change.
landing.shareFeature1Desc: Generate a link in 10 seconds, send it on WhatsApp, and anyone who opens it can view the tree — or add members, if you grant edit access.
landing.shareFeature2Desc: Decide how many people can use the link, how many members each one can add, and how long it stays active. Revoke access anytime, with one click.
landing.messagingBadge: The whole family, in one place
landing.messagingTitle: Chat with family, right inside eArbore
landing.messagingBody: Once you've shared the tree with someone, you can message them directly from the app — no more digging through 5 WhatsApp groups just to find a birth date or an old photo.
landing.messagingFeature1Desc: Message relatives you've shared the tree with directly, or create a group for the whole branch of the family helping fill it in.
landing.messagingFeature2Desc: Simple read receipts — you know when your relative has seen the photo or question you sent, without unnecessary pressure.
landing.faq5Q: Can I invite relatives without them creating an account?
landing.faq5A: Yes — you generate a sharing link, send it over, and that person can view or fill in the tree directly, no account and no password needed. You control what they're allowed to do.
landing.faq6Q: Can I talk to relatives directly from the app?
landing.faq6A: Yes — once you've shared the tree with a relative (via link or account), you can send messages right from eArbore, in a private conversation or a group.
landing.finalCtaTitle: 10 years from now, someone in your family will want to see exactly what you're building today.
landing.finalCtaSubtitle: It costs nothing to start. It costs everything to not do it in time.
landing.agitateTitle: How many of your family's stories are already lost?
landing.feature1Desc: Name, photo, birth date — and link them to the family with a simple click. No tutorial needed.
landing.feature2Desc: See entire generations at a glance, with drag & drop for quick reorganizing.
landing.feature3Desc: Every member has their own page with a biography, like a short article about their life.
landing.feature4Desc: Photos are uploaded and secured automatically — they're never lost.
landing.feature5Desc: Not just parent-child — link partnerships too, as well as connections between families.
landing.feature6Desc: From your phone or laptop, your family tree is always one click away.
landing.howTitle: Three steps. A few minutes. Done.
landing.step1Desc: No card, no commitment. Just email and password.
landing.step2Desc: You, your parents, your grandparents — then gradually expand to the rest of the family.
landing.step3Title: Watch your family come to life
landing.step3Desc: The tree builds itself, visually, as you add connections.
landing.socialProofLabel: People already preserving their family's story
landing.testimonial1: I managed to gather in two evenings all the history my grandmother had been telling me for years. Now it won't be lost.
landing.testimonial2: I discovered relatives I knew nothing about, just by rebuilding the tree with my parents.
landing.testimonial3: The interface is so simple that even my 78-year-old grandfather managed to add his own photo.
landing.supportTitle: We don't sell subscriptions. We don't lock features.
landing.supportBody: eArbore is free for everyone, forever. Servers, photo storage, and ongoing development cost money — if the platform helps you, a donation (however small) keeps us online for one more family.
landing.donateTier1Impact: Supports the servers for a day
landing.donateTier3Impact: Keeps the platform online for a month
landing.faq1Q: Is it really free, with no hidden costs?
landing.faq1A: Yes. We don't ask for a card at sign-up and we don't lock features behind a subscription. Donations are 100% optional.
landing.faq2Q: What happens to my family's photos and data?
landing.faq2A: They're stored securely and are never sold or shared with third parties. Your tree is private, visible only to you.
landing.faq3A: Yes, you can mark a member as deceased and keep their story, photos, and data — just like any other member.
landing.faq4Q: How big can the tree get?
landing.faq4A: There's no artificial limit — you can add as many generations and relatives as you need.
